http/cookie_client#

Sending and keeping cookies around a client.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let client = CookieExchanging(origin: HttpClient(), jar: MemoryCookieJar(), contexts: FirstPartyCookies());
await client.response(Request(url: "https://example.com/"));

Description#

Sending and keeping cookies around a client.

HttpClient(cookies: jar) does this for you. The jar's cookies go out in one Cookie field; the Set-Cookie fields of every hop are kept. A Cookie field the caller set is refused unless CallerCookiePolicy says to keep or replace it.
